title: Freestanding Coat Rack 60-Inch Brass Assorted Free Standing Accessorie | Allied Brass
short_title: Assorted Free Standing Accessorie Coat Rack 60-Inch | Allied Brass
description:
Add flexible, no-drill storage to your bathroom with this freestanding coat rack crafted from brass and designed with pivoting pegs. A weighted base helps keep the rack stable to resist tipping, while a felt pad helps protect floors from scratches. Its traditional styling is designed to coordinate with traditional bathroom hardware and classic bath accessories.

Highlights:
- Freestanding design requires no wall mounting
- Brass construction
- Pivoting pegs help organize robes, towels, and accessories
- Weighted base helps keep the rack stable
- Felt pad helps prevent scratching on surfaces

Specs:
- Overall size: 60-Inch H x 10-Inch W x 10-Inch L
- Weight capacity: 18 lb
- Product weight: 14.4 lb
- Mounting type: Freestanding
- Assembly required: Yes
- Included: Freestanding coat rack

Finish options: Available in multiple designer finish options, including statement colors for coordinating with heritage bathroom fixtures.

_previous.title: Free Standing Coat Rack with Eight Pivoting Pegs
_previous.description: Keeping your coats, hats and other accessories organized is now easier than ever, with this free standing coat rack, with six pivoting pegs. Designed in a stylish manner, this coat rack is a modern tool for every home or business. Its finish makes it elegant and nice, thus giving a fashionable look to any space. Its six pivoting pegs are displayed in an innovative manner, which creates a truly organized space for your coats and hats. Nicely designed, this coat rack is an excellent choice not only for its performance, but also for its ability to add some style to the overall décor.
